articles.summary: For International Ataxia Awareness Day, we’re honoring the voices of people living with Friedreich’s ataxia (FA) by highlighting a common thread that runs through every story: the power of community. articles.title: How the Friedreich’s Ataxia Community Finds Strength in Connection
